name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: You were clear this isn't a customer service role, it's accountability and results. That's the job I already do. At Solenzo, I built the lead capture, appointment-booking, and no-show-recovery systems that a service-based business owner's revenue actually depends on, then sat with those owners on the numbers, not to report them, but to push on what wasn't working and why.

The accountability side is proven, not aspirational. At Birdeye, I managed 15-20 reseller partners, diagnosed adoption gaps from real utilization data rather than guesswork, and held roughly 94% retention by having the direct conversations that fixed the actual problem instead of the symptom. At Accelo, I ranked top three on a team of 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, and escalated account risk early rather than let it surface as a surprise. I haven't worked in the fitness vertical specifically, but the function, diagnosing a local business owner's bottleneck and holding them to the fix, is exactly what I've been doing.
I'd welcome the chance to bring that to gym owners specifically. If a track record of real accountability and real systems-building is what you're looking for, let's talk.
